changelog:
v2.8.8 — Ghost Mode fix: Calculator disguise

Dialer secret codes (*#*#2001#*#*) are not honored by the stock Samsung dialer, so the return gate failed on real devices. Fixed: Ghost Mode now disguises the launcher icon as a real, working Calculator app.

To enter Ghost Mode: System section -> Disguise as Calculator.
To return: open the calculator icon, type 2001, tap =.
Any other calculation works normally -- nothing looks suspicious.
